items.quote: 7:8 Of clean beasts, and of beasts that are not clean, and of fowls, and of every thing that creepeth upon the earth, 7:9 There went in two and two unto Noah into the ark, the male and the female, as God had commanded Noah.
items.claim: Animals of every kind entered Noah's ark in pairs (male and female) as God commanded.
items.actor: clean beasts, beasts that are not clean, fowls, every thing that creepeth upon the earth
